steps.name: The picture, to P1's budget
steps.changed: The game's High keeps Epic's reflections and lighting, and the first launch settles there at 55% on this PC (11.0 ms a frame): the street keeps 2.5 ms of the card for the proof view by day, 1.4 ms at night, and the rooms behind the windows stay lit.
steps.verdict: Measured, not reviewed: GPU 11.04 ms at the hook camera with the voice speaking, the same as the mix P1 chose.
steps.caption: The played street from the hook camera at the new picture, 3440 by 1440, the game's own light. Still unfinished and owned by later steps: the people's clothes (the clothing session), the dark shop windows (2.6), the props (2.8).

steps.name: Composition
steps.changed: Across from Mickey's, single-storey cottages under slated roofs where a two-storey wall filled the left of the frame; the shop row behind them slated in place of its flat top; the telegraph pole and its wires off the sky; the camera, vanishing point and horizon fitted to the sheet.
steps.verdict: Accepted by you on 3 October, evening ("the composition is right"), after three fresh reviews that each came closer.
steps.caption: The hook camera, 2560 by 1440, the game's own light, the third try. Still unfinished and owned by later steps: the fog and sky (2.2), the wet road (2.3), the hill (2.9), Mickey's dark window (2.6).

steps.name: Atmosphere and sky
steps.changed: The day's fog thinner and paler, so the hill keeps its brick and cream and fades toward the sky as it climbs; the near street clear; the overcast pale, not white. No chimney smoke: the Hook sheet shows none, and the first method drew nothing.
steps.verdict: Three fresh reviews: the street's haze, the sky and the hill's legibility pass; still short, narrowly, the haze building toward the hill's crest, its colour a shade darker than the sky, and the clouds' contrast against KCD2. Closed with those notes, carried to the hill (2.9) and the grade (2.13).
steps.caption: The hook camera, 2560 by 1440, the game's own light. Still unfinished and owned by later steps: the dark gable behind the cottages (2.1, set aside), the road's pale sheen (2.3), Mickey's dark window (2.6), the hill's block houses (2.9), the stiff people (2.11).
